title: Afghanistan
author: Chaitali Chattopadhyay
text:
She has laid herself by the darkness thinking,
`How far pungent the odour of blood can be!`
The wall has reached her forehead,
her eyes- won`t they be able to catch a glimpse of the sky?
Would they flow and flow forward?
Be engrossed in the sound of blast?
The flowers must be in bloom somewhere,
she thinks-
The birds chirp.
The timid girls sing.
The heart lives in innocence,
while this world proceeds inchmeal
transforming itself into Afghanistan.

Translated by Shyamashri Ray Karmakar
